Data.String: PIC-205: loop pressure at V-101, sets FIC-108 (P-01). AIC-210: H2 in the recycle gas, sets the purge FIC-211. FFI-217: H2/aromatics ratio from FI-216, AIC-210, FIC-108, FIC-103, low alarm (D-007). C&E I-201, I-202, I-203

K-101: anti-surge UIC-207 (FT-218, PT-219, PT-220) on UV-207, HG-232 back to E-102 inlet (P-01); TI-221, VI-222; surge map, lube oil, seals in the package (D-025); no discharge PSV; trips C&E I-202, I-203. XV-209: I-102 or HS-209
PSV-214: V-101 fire and loop blocked outlet; PSV-215: E-102 tube rupture (42 barg into CW) and thermal, to the flare via FL-234; HV-237: minimum flow of P-102/P-102B (D-025)
